title: Italian artist reimagines Madonna paintings to expose Gaza’s pain
html:
Italian artist reimagines Madonna paintings to expose Gaza’s pain

Italian artist Eduardo Castaldo has unveiled an artwork titled ‘Holy Mothers of Gaza’ inside Naples’ Pappacoda Chapel. By peeling back the painting’s outer layer, the work reveals an actual photograph from Gaza, captured by Palestinian photojournalist Omar El Qattaa.
summary: Italian artist Eduardo Castaldo has unveiled an artwork titled ‘Holy Mothers of Gaza’ inside Naples’ Pappacoda Chapel.
